title: Grant Collision — Logical OR Combines req and mask
description: The grant output uses logical OR of req and mask instead of AND-NOT; this combines the request vector with the priority mask, granting masters that either requested OR are in the mask, producing simultaneous multi-master grants.
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [MULTI_GNT] gnt=2'b11; both masters granted simultaneously via req|mask collision
expected_root_cause: The grant computation uses bitwise OR (req | mask) instead of AND-NOT (req & ~mask); the OR operation grants any master whose bit is set in either the request or the priority mask, producing multi-master grants whenever any priority mask bit is set.
rtl: assign gnt = req | mask;  // Logical OR: grants masters in mask even if they didn't request
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [MULTI_GNT] gnt=2'b11; both masters granted simultaneously via req|mask collision
success_log: gnt is always one-hot. No simultaneous grants. Masked rotation works correctly.
fix_replacement:
assign masked_req = req & ~priority_mask;
assign gnt = masked_req ? masked_req : req;  // Fall back to req if mask excludes all
